message:
Running command: cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cd /gt/_work/src 2>/dev/null || cd /workspace/_work/src; set -e; mkdir -p build/sanitize/lib; if [ -x build/sanitize/mutool ] && [ ! -f build/sanitize/mutool.bin ]; then mv build/sanitize/mutool build/sanitize/mutool.bin; fi; ldd build/sanitize/mutool.bin | awk "{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if (\$i ~ /^\//) print \$i}" | while read p; do cp -L "$p" build/sanitize/lib/ 2>/dev/null || true; done; cat > build/sanitize/mutool <<"SH"
#!/bin/sh
DIR="$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$DIR/lib${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
exec "$DIR/mutool.bin" "$@"
SH
chmod +x build/sanitize/mutool; ldd build/sanitize/mutool.bin; ls -lh build/sanitize/mutool build/sanitize/mutool.bin build/sanitize/lib | head -80'
